# `toolu brainstorm`

Think a change through before building (a Markdown-only plugin).

Owner: `plugins/brainstorm`.

## `toolu brainstorm`

```text
brainstorm is a Markdown-only plugin: it has no verbs. Its skill thinks a change through before building: evidence-backed triage, alternatives, trade-offs and a recommended approach, without editing code.

Run it as /brainstorm:brainstorm in Claude Code or $brainstorm:brainstorm in Codex. delivery-flow runs it as its first phase.

Usage: toolu brainstorm [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json
          Print exactly one JSON document on stdout

  -q, --quiet
          Drop the diagnostics of a successful run

      --host <HOST>
          The host to act for, instead of the detected one

          [possible values: claude, codex, opencode, cursor, hermes]

      --config-dir <DIR>
          Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
